### 🩺 Scope

phase=9.0.0 range=v8.0.0..HEAD model=opus

Twenty-four commits, 866 tracked files. Read every one of the fifteen tracked directories plus the sixteen root files: `.claude-plugin`, `.github`, `.rot-lists`, `LICENSES`, `agents`, `artifacts`, `bin`, `checker`, `commands`, `docs`, `dtd`, `lib`, `monitors`, `skills`, `src`, and root. Ran the two mandated controls (`ai-slop.mjs controls` 0 failing, ban list 117, measures 8, laws 8; `ordinals.mjs controls` 0 failing) and re-ran the gate's own instruments: `counts-sweep` 57 places, `glossary --check`, `plates --check` 16, `readme-index --check`, `controls-sweep --check` 31 claims 0 drifted, `enum-sweep` 5619 enumerations, `subsets-sweep --check` 28 blocks, `creators-audit`, `engines-sweep`, `about-sweep`, `tracked-sweep`, `spdx-sweep` 841 files, `encoding.mjs sweep` 861 files 0 bad, `list table/reach`, `release-notes --versions` 9.0.0 everywhere, `regression claims/retenue/unreached` clean, `checker-controls.sh` 22 controls, and the typography, geometry, figure, chain and cache controls. Own byte sweep of all 866 files: 0 BOM, 0 CR outside `docs/gifs/*.gif`, 0 forbidden control bytes. Own law-numbering sweep of 682 `.md` and `.dtd` files: the nine gaps are subset continuations and one README sample, not defects. `LICENSES/` byte-identical to the three root licence files. Findings below are in `checker`, `.github` and `dtd`.

### 🩺 Findings

<finding file="checker/glossary.mjs" line="525" severity="high" confidence="measured">The control asserting "no external stylesheet or script is referenced" cannot fail. Its predicate is `page.indexOf('http') === page.lastIndexOf('http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml11/DTD/xhtml11.dtd') || true`, and the trailing `|| true` forces PASS whatever the page contains. Landed proof, on the committed page held byte-identical by `--check`: `docs/glossary.xhtml` is 194006 bytes, `indexOf("http")` = 90 and `lastIndexOf(dtd url)` = 90. Splicing `<link rel="stylesheet" href="http://example.com/evil.css" />` and `<script src="http://example.com/evil.js"></script>` before `</head>` gives 194116 bytes and leaves both operands at 90, so even the bare predicate stays true on a page that does load a remote stylesheet and a remote script; the regex on line 526 returns false on that same mutant and is the only thing actually measuring the claim. One of the fifteen the file reports as "glossary controls: 15 run" is decorative, and `checker/controls-sweep.mjs --check` holds the CHANGELOG to that inflated fifteen.</finding>

<finding file="checker/glossary.mjs" line="599" severity="medium" confidence="measured">The write path reports "xhtml page, 2 svg plates and the README block written" after writing forty SVG files: line 588 and line 589 write the two map plates, and the loop on line 590 writes every pair from `familyPlates`. Measured on the tree: `git ls-files docs` returns 38 `docs/family-*.svg` and 2 `docs/glossary-map*.svg`. The `--check` message on line 583 has the same fault the other way, saying "both svg plates" after the list built on lines 561 and 562 compared all forty. A run that touches forty committed files and names two is the count drift `checker/counts-sweep.mjs` exists to prevent, in the file that generates the page counts-sweep reads.</finding>

<finding file=".github/workflows/gate.yml" line="149" severity="medium" confidence="measured">The step `node lib/ai-slop.mjs sweep dtd/sigil artifacts/research --max 0` walks directories, not the index, so its subject set differs between this machine and CI. Measured: the sweep reads 22 files here and enumerates `artifacts/research/CLAUDE.md` among them; `git ls-files --error-unmatch artifacts/research/CLAUDE.md` exits 1 and `git check-ignore -v` names `.gitignore:41` (`**/artifacts/**/CLAUDE.md`). A fresh checkout sweeps 21. `checker/tracked-sweep.sh` is the instrument for exactly this class, and its own control message says an ignored target "passes here and drifts on a fresh checkout", but its scope is `commands, skills, agents` only, so neither directory this step added in 9.0.0 is covered by it.</finding>

<finding file="dtd/cc-schematic.dtd" line="529" severity="medium" confidence="measured">The file ends without a terminating LF: 72130 bytes, last byte 0x3E, the closing `>` of the final `LAW.ASK.1` entity. It is the only one of the 31 `dtd/*.dtd` files so, and the only tracked text file in the tree so (own byte sweep of all 866 files: `dtd/cc-schematic.dtd` is the single non-GIF entry with no final LF); `dtd/cc-core.dtd`, `dtd/cc-ask.dtd`, `dtd/cc-sigil.dtd` and `dtd/cc-cache.dtd` all end in 0x0A. `.gitattributes:3` declares `* text=auto eol=lf`, but `lib/encoding.mjs` judges only CR, BOM and forbidden control bytes, so the sweep reporting "861 files checked, 0 bad" has no arm that can trip on a missing terminator. `checker/subsets-sweep.mjs:19` declares a block body is "dtd/<name>.dtd without its final newline" and line 61 strips one with `replace(/\n$/, '')`; for this file the strip removes nothing, so the invariant reads as satisfied for the one file that never had the newline to strip.</finding>

<finding file=".github/workflows/gate.yml" line="152" severity="low" confidence="measured">The step is named "the root documents pass the slop measures" but runs six of the nine root markdown documents. `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` and `SUPPORT.md` are outside it. Judged each by hand under `node lib/ai-slop.mjs`: all three exit 0, alive, `tells value=0 bound=0 holds=yes` (422, 131 and 96 words). Nothing is failing; the step's name claims a set wider than the six files it names.</finding>

<finding file="docs/HOSTED-PLUGIN.md" line="110" severity="low" confidence="measured">The only prose document under `docs/` sits outside every slop sweep in the gate: 1532 words, 194 sentences, and `node lib/ai-slop.mjs docs/HOSTED-PLUGIN.md` reports `kind=hedge "kind of"` at line 110 and `kind=filler "very" say: cut it` at line 197. It would pass a `--max 0` sweep (tells 0, mattr 0.7294), so this is scope rather than content: the file is never judged by the gate, and the two hits stand unaddressed because nothing reads them.</finding>

<finding file="checker/glossary.mjs" line="603" severity="low" confidence="measured">The main-detection guard dereferences `process.argv[1]` without checking it, so importing the module as a library throws before any export is reachable: `await import("file:///.../checker/glossary.mjs")` under `node --input-type=module -e` failed this session with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'split')` at glossary.mjs:603. Every sibling guards the same test, for instance `checker/subsets-sweep.mjs:116` opens with `process.argv[1] &&`. The file exports `render`, `card`, `familyOf`, `splice` and `familyPlates` as though they were reusable, and none can be reached that way.</finding>

### 🩺 Verdict

The tree is in step on every count it publishes and every instrument it names: one version everywhere at 9.0.0, 57 places, 31 controls claims, 28 subset blocks, 5619 enumerations, 1928 declarations, 22 checker controls all tripping as designed, and a byte sweep that finds no CR and no BOM anywhere outside the GIFs. The eleven earlier passes have closed the easy ground.

What remains is one defect of the kind this repository is built to refuse. `checker/glossary.mjs:525` is a control that cannot trip, and its `|| true` is not a near-miss: the predicate it disables was already unable to detect the property its own message names, since neither operand moves when a remote stylesheet and a remote script are spliced into the page. It sits one line above the regex that does the real work, it is counted in the fifteen the file reports, and `controls-sweep --check` then holds the CHANGELOG faithfully to that inflated number — the alarm-that-was-never-tripped failure, inside the alarm-counting machinery. Three medium findings follow from the same root: a report that names two of the forty files it wrote, a gate step whose subject set is a directory walk that picks up a git-ignored file, and one DTD that ends without its terminator in a tree whose encoding sweep has no arm for that class.

None of this breaks a shipped artifact. All of it breaks the claim that every control here has been made to go red.

### 🩺 Next

Delete `|| true` from `checker/glossary.mjs:525` and either drop the line (line 526 already proves the claim) or give it a predicate a planted `<link href="http...">` falsifies, then re-run `checker/controls-sweep.mjs --check` so the CHANGELOG's fifteen follows the change. Compute the plate count from `familyPlates(entries).length + 2` in both messages at lines 583 and 599. Widen `checker/tracked-sweep.sh` to `dtd/sigil` and `artifacts/research`, or have `lib/ai-slop.mjs sweep` take its file list from `git ls-files` so the local and CI subject sets are the same 21. Append the newline to `dtd/cc-schematic.dtd` and add a fourth arm to `lib/encoding.mjs judge` for a text file with no terminating LF, with a planted control beside the CR, BOM and control-byte ones. Add `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, `SUPPORT.md` and `docs/HOSTED-PLUGIN.md` to the root-documents step. Guard line 603 with `process.argv[1] &&`.

COMPANION VERDICT: fail
